facts.fact: On 29 July 2026 the digital ministry, through Sénégal Numérique S.A. with PAENS support, held a workshop presenting interim results of the Government Enterprise Architecture project under the New Deal Technologique, briefed participants on the PM-chaired GouvNum Committee and launched an inventory of the state's information systems.

systems.owner: Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Affairs; implementer Sénégal Numérique S.A.

note: Calls the New Deal Technologique an 'agenda' without describing its scope, so class is left empty.
